commands:
set -u
printf %s  | base64 -d > /tmp/n83-metric-inner.sh
chmod 700 /tmp/n83-metric-inner.sh
echo ACCOUNTING_BEGIN
systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --unit=n83-metric-v2-accounting --property=CPUAccounting=yes --property=MemoryAccounting=yes /bin/bash /tmp/n83-metric-inner.sh
echo ACCOUNTING_EXIT:$?
echo QUOTA1600_BEGIN
systemd-run --wait --pipe --collect --unit=n83-metric-v2-quota1600 --property=CPUAccounting=yes --property=MemoryAccounting=yes --property=CPUQuota=1600% /bin/bash /tmp/n83-metric-inner.sh
echo QUOTA1600_EXIT:$?
echo PROBE_V2_END
